$comment: One base plus overlays composited at render time, which is how a 2D world gets combinatorial
appearance out of 48 assets instead of thousands: 4 builds x 8^5 = 131,072 distinct avatars
before colourway. All 48 are 256x512 and therefore NON-SQUARE, so they are the largest block
of assets in this repository exposed to Qwen's transposed `size`.
REGISTRATION IS THE FAILURE THAT HIDES. Every overlay is generated against the same base
silhouette, stated in the prompt below and checked by verify.py check 7 as a bounding-box
containment test. A misregistered overlay is invisible in a contact sheet and obvious in play —
which is the definition of a check worth automating.
silhouette: a standing adult figure occupying the centre of a tall narrow frame, head near the top with a small margin above it, feet just above the bottom edge, arms at the sides, the whole figure about two thirds of the frame width and centred left to right

builds.subject: a slight, narrow-shouldered adult of average height
a broad, heavy-set adult of average height

poses.subject: seen from directly in front, weight even, arms relaxed at the sides
seen from the left side in profile, weight even, arms relaxed at the sides

slots.region: the head only — the top quarter of the frame; everything below the jaw is empty
